messages:
ara: quick check — we have a planned breaking cleanup for header semantics (remove legacy X-Auth) hitting marketplace validator next month. want to sync on partner-facing timeline + migration help. :loud_sound:
ben: important — lots of SI customers still running pinned older SDKs. can we offer a compatibility shim and a short guaranteed grace period?
lina: current thought: ship shim libs for node/python, announce 60-day deprecation window, and include a pre-flight checker partners can run locally. shorter window keeps the backlog small.
partner-eng-oliver: 60 days is tighter than some partners expect. ask: can we provide a toggle in marketplace so partners can opt into strict validation early for testing? that would help SIs schedule rollouts.
ara: yes — good idea. we can add an "early opt-in" flag to the pre-checker and marketplace metadata. we'll also publish a compatibility test harness on GH. link to the draft repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-compat-harness
ben: sample migration curl (for partners): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/test -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
lina: marketplace validator will return 400 with a clear code when it rejects legacy headers. propose payload: ```json
{"code":"deprecated_header","message":"X-Auth header is deprecated. Use Authorization: Bearer <token>. See /partners/migrate"}
```
partner-eng-oliver: can we get a backstop plan for Dedicated/Private customers where proxy layers might rewrite headers? request in-checklist: verify proxy header mapping and KMS auth flows.
ara: agreed. checklist items: 1) verify header passthrough for Private, 2) run the pre-checker in CI, 3) install shim if immediate migration is not possible, 4) join partner office hours.
ben: timeline proposal: announce tomorrow; publish shim + pre-checker in 48hrs; enable marketplace strict validation in 30 days; hard reject in 60 days. partners get an automated email + a support ticket template.
lina: I'll own the pre-checker + docs. ben you own shim libs + npm/pypi releases. oliver you own partner comms and office hours. ara will coordinate marketplace toggle.
devops-bot: @ben  scheduled canary job created: job/partner-compat-canary-178001. Canary runs Tue 02:00 UTC. CI will post results to #eng-releases. :robot_face:
partner-eng-oliver: thanks — I'll start drafting the partner email and include migration snippets and timelines. please ping me when shims are published so I can include install commands.
ara: one more note: include a short script partners can run to detect rewrites behind their proxies. we'll add that to the pre-checker. will post the announcement draft here for review once ready. keep replies short. :thumbsup:
